build_pyrobot_simulator: build a python module to initialize a PyRobot simulator with configured sensors and robot type
create_rgb_sensor: create a PyRobotRGBSensor class that captures and resizes RGB observations from a robot camera
create_depth_sensor: create a PyRobotDepthSensor class that captures depth observations with optional normalization to 0-1 range
test_pyrobot_step: test the PyRobot step method to execute base or camera actions and return sensor observations
review_pyrobot_bump_sensor: review the PyRobotBumpSensor class that reads bumper collision state from the robot base
